name: Tachibana Izumi
source:
The daughter of Mankai Company's previous director. She travels to Veludo after receiving a mysterious letter hinting about his whereabouts, but in an unexpected turn of events she ended up assuming the role of director as well as the supervisor of the theater.

[Edited from [url=https://a3-liber.com/story.html]Official site[/url]]
